title: NEGATIVE
MARKING
scenes.sub: Not every wrong answer costs marks
scenes.voice: In GATE, not every wrong answer costs you marks. Know this rule before your next mock.

scenes.title: A Wrong Answer Costs
scenes.voice: In multiple choice questions, a wrong one mark answer costs one third of a mark, and a wrong two mark answer costs two thirds.

scenes.title: NAT and MSQ
scenes.voice: Numerical answer questions have no negative marking at all. Multiple select questions also have no negative marking, but no partial marks. You must select every correct option, and nothing else.

scenes.title: What To Do
scenes.voice: So, never leave a numerical question blank. Type your best answer. In multiple select, answer if you are fairly sure. In multiple choice, guess only when you can remove two options.
